# Azure Upgrade — Plans, SKUs & SDK Modernizer

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's in-Azure upgrade skill: assess, then automate upgrades between plans, tiers and SKUs — Azure Functions Consumption to Flex Consumption, Azure Cache for Redis (Basic/Standard/Premium and Enterprise) to Azure Managed Redis, App Service to Container Apps — plus source-code modernization of legacy Java Azure SDKs (`com.microsoft.azure.*` → `com.azure.*`), with scenario references, idempotent resumable automation scripts, and handoff to azure-validate/azure-deploy afterwards.
